title: Oops!...I Did It Again
description: 《Oops! ...I Did It Again》描寫一段充滿曖昧、誤解與感情遊戲的戀愛關係。歌中的主角發現自己再次讓對方誤以為兩人正在相愛，但她其實並沒有打算認真投入這段感情。她享受被追求與喜歡的感覺，卻也承認自己經常不自覺地玩弄別人的感情。雖然她幻想童話般的浪漫愛情，渴望真正的英雄出現，但現實中的她並不像外表那麼天真無邪。歌曲以輕鬆幽默的方式展現愛情中的矛盾與不成熟。最終，《Oops! ...I Did It Again》傳達的是戀愛中的誘惑、幻想與自我認識：曖昧有時令人興奮，但若沒有清楚表達真實感受，也可能在無意間傷害別人的心。

vocabulary.meaning: 再做一次；又做了同樣的事
vocabulary.usage: 當某件事情已經做過，現在又重複做時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Do it again」？
options: I called my boss “Mum” again. Yes, I did it again.
I did it again to called the wrong number.
She do it again yesterday at the dance class.
We did it again very ten years old.
vocabulary.explanation: do it again 表示再次做了同一件事。
optionExplanations: do it again 表示再次做了同一件事。
to 後用 call，不能接 called。
過去事件須用 did it again。
did it again 不能接 very ten years old 描述年齡。

vocabulary.meaning: 不只是朋友；關係比普通朋友更親近
vocabulary.usage: 當兩人的關係可能是戀愛關係，而不只是朋友時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「More than just friends」？
options: They more than just friends after the trip.
Tom and Mia are more than just friends. They are dating.
I more than just friends my neighbour.
We are more than just friends to dated for a year.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。兩人正在約會，關係不只是普通朋友。
optionExplanations: more than just friends 是名詞片語，句子缺少 are 等動詞。
正確。兩人正在約會，關係不只是普通朋友。
more than just friends 不能單獨作動詞。
to dated 的連接不成立；可另說 We have dated for a year。

vocabulary.usage: 當你喜歡某人，但還不是正式交往時，可以使用 have a crush on + 人。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Have a crush on」？
options: I have a crush to the new singer.
She has a crush on to her neighbour.
We has a crush on the same actor.
I have a crush on Sam, but I am too shy to tell him.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。對 Sam 有好感，但害羞不敢說，符合「暗戀」。
optionExplanations: have a crush 後接對象用 on，不能用 to。
on 後直接接 her neighbour，不加 to。
主詞 we 配 have，不能用 has。
正確。對 Sam 有好感，但害羞不敢說，符合「暗戀」。

vocabulary.usage: 根據外表或目前看到的情況做猜測時，可以使用 seem like + 名詞／句子。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Seem like」？
options: That seems like a good idea. Let’s try it!
She seems like to go home at six.
The plan seems like to a good idea.
I seem like to danced on stage.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。用 seem like 表示「聽起來／看起來是個好主意」。
optionExplanations: 正確。用 seem like 表示「聽起來／看起來是個好主意」。
錯誤。seem like 後面不能直接接 to + 動詞；可以說 She seems to want to go home.
seems like 後直接接名詞片語，不加 to。
seem like 後不能接 to danced。

vocabulary.usage: 當你想表明你是真的這樣想，不是在開玩笑時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Be serious」？
options: I am serious to my first interview yesterday.
Are you serious? You invited the whole street?
He is serious the window because it is cold.
Please serious the music before bed.
vocabulary.explanation: Are you serious? 用來確認令人驚訝的消息。
optionExplanations: serious 後可用 about；現在式 am 也不配 yesterday。
Are you serious? 用來確認令人驚訝的消息。
錯誤。serious 不是「關窗戶」；應說 He closes the window.
錯誤。serious 不是動詞，不能這樣使用；可說 Please turn off the music.

vocabulary.usage: 當人不知道自己在哪裡，或不知道該往哪裡走時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Get lost」？
options: I got lost to the hotel yesterday.
We get lost yesterday near the museum.
We got lost in the city, so we asked a man for help.
She got lost the TV because it was funny.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。在城市中找不到方向，所以向人求助。
optionExplanations: 迷路於某地用 got lost in；got lost to 不表示前往某地。
過去事件應用 got lost。
正確。在城市中找不到方向，所以向人求助。
錯誤。get lost 不能這樣接電視；可說 She watched the funny show.

vocabulary.usage: 當一個人對另一個人有深厚的愛情時，可以使用 be in love (with someone)。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「In love」？
options: I am in love to the new actor.
Nina is in love with Alex. She smiles whenever she sees him.
They are in love the bus at eight.
They in love after their first date.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。in love with + 人，表示 Nina 愛上 Alex。
optionExplanations: in love 後接對象用 with，不能用 to。
正確。in love with + 人，表示 Nina 愛上 Alex。
錯誤。搭公車不會用 in love；應說 They are on the bus at eight.
in love 描述狀態，前面需要 are 等動詞。

vocabulary.usage: 當一個人沒有做錯事，或沒有犯某個被懷疑的錯誤時，可以使用。
options: Leo did not take the money. He is innocent.
I innocent my bike to the park after lunch.
She has an innocent on her desk for writing.
My cousin innocent to the missing money.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。Leo 沒有拿走錢，所以是無辜的。
optionExplanations: 正確。Leo 沒有拿走錢，所以是無辜的。
錯誤。innocent 是形容詞，不是騎車的動詞；應說 I rode my bike to the park.
錯誤。innocent 不是文具名稱；可說 She has a pencil on her desk.
innocent 是形容詞，不能單獨作動詞；此句的介詞也不合適。

vocabulary.usage: 當你想請對方暫停，或突然想到一件事時，可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Wait a minute」？
options: Wait a minute to checked the address.
I wait a minute my manager yesterday.
Wait a minute! I left my phone at home.
We wait a minute the door so it stays open.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確。突然想起手機忘在家裡，用這句請人稍等。
optionExplanations: to 後用 check，不能接 checked。
wait a minute 不能直接接 my manager；過去事件也須用 waited。
正確。突然想起手機忘在家裡，用這句請人稍等。
錯誤。要說「扶住門」應用 hold the door，而不是 wait a minute.

vocabulary.meaning: 你真貼心／你不必這麼破費（收到禮物時的客氣話）
vocabulary.usage: 別人送你禮物或特別幫你做了好事時，可以用來表示驚喜與感謝。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「You shouldn’t have」？
options: You shouldn't have to bought me a gift.
I you shouldn't have my birthday present.
You shouldn't have buy me flowers!
You bought me flowers? You shouldn't have! Thank you!
vocabulary.explanation: You shouldn't have! 可用來客氣地感謝別人的禮物。
optionExplanations: shouldn't have 後接過去分詞 bought，不加 to。
You shouldn't have 是完整說法，不能插在 I 與受詞之間當動詞。
shouldn't have 後要用過去分詞 bought，不能用 buy。
You shouldn't have! 可用來客氣地感謝別人的禮物。

questions.word: think + 省略 that 的陳述子句
questions.meaning: 我認為／我想某事是真的。
questions.usage: 表達尚未完全確定的看法；歌詞省略 that。
questions.prompt: 修理師看了舊鐘，認為它還能運作。他怎樣說？
options: I think this clock can work again.
I think working this clock again.
I think can this clock work again.
I think this clock to work again.
optionExplanations: 正確：我認為／我想某事是真的。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。
錯誤：working 不能代替完整的陳述子句。
錯誤：間接陳述應用主詞在前的語序。
錯誤：think 後不能直接用受詞加 to work 表示此想法。
questions.cue: I think I did it again
questions.explanation: 正確：我認為／我想某事是真的。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。

questions.meaning: 過去又做了一次同樣的事。
questions.usage: 描述已完成的重複行動。
questions.prompt: 陶藝家昨天做過一個杯子，今天又做了一個同樣的杯子。
options: I make the same cup again yesterday.
I made the same cup again today.
I making the same cup again today.
I made again the same cup yesterday tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：昨天需用過去式 made，不用現在式 make。
正確：過去又做了一次同樣的事。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。
錯誤：主句缺少 be 動詞，且未表達完整時態。
錯誤：yesterday 與 tomorrow 互相衝突，語序也不自然。
questions.explanation: 正確：過去又做了一次同樣的事。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。

錯誤：by 指動作方式或執行者，不表示「替某人」。
questions.explanation: 正確：為某人取得某物。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。

questions.meaning: 原意是「過去不應該做」，在收禮時也可作感謝的客套話。
questions.usage: 說過去行為不妥，或收到貼心禮物時客氣回應；原歌省略已知動作。
questions.prompt: 朋友送了一件貼心小禮物，你驚喜地回應。
options: You shouldn’t having! Thank you so much!
You shouldn’t have! Thank you so much!
You shouldn’t had! Thank you so much!
You shouldn’t has! Thank you so much!
optionExplanations: 錯誤：shouldn’t 後不能直接使用 having。
正確：原意是「過去不應該做」，在收禮時也可作感謝的客套話。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。
錯誤：shouldn’t 後不用 had。
錯誤：情態動詞後需原形 have。
questions.explanation: 正確：原意是「過去不應該做」，在收禮時也可作感謝的客套話。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。

questions.meaning: 最後／結果如何。
questions.usage: 談事情結束時發生的結果。
questions.prompt: 雖然比賽一開始很難，球隊最後贏了。
options: In end, our team won the game.
In the ending, our team won the game.
In the end, our team won the game.
At the end, our team won the game of finally.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：固定短語需要 the。
錯誤：表示「結果／最後」常用 in the end，不用 in the ending。
正確：最後／結果如何。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。
錯誤：at the end 常需說明某事的末端，這句結構不自然。
questions.explanation: 正確：最後／結果如何。 這句在題目情境中語意自然，且結構完整。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 使某人相信某事
questions.usage: 談論言語、證據或行為如何讓人形成某種信念。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「make someone believe」？
options: The picture made us believe into a blue bicycle.
The picture made us believe for three hours of rain.
The picture made us believe the story was real.
The picture made us believe at the train station.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：believe into 不適用此意，句意也不完整。
錯誤：believe for three hours of rain 不能表達相信的內容。
正確：照片讓我們相信故事是真的，搭配 make + 人 + believe + 子句。
錯誤：believe 後的地點片語不能自然表示「相信某件事」。
questions.explanation: 正確：照片讓我們相信故事是真的，搭配 make + 人 + believe + 子句。

questions.meaning: 感官；理智（依語境）
questions.usage: 常見 come to one’s senses 表示恢復理智；lose one’s senses 可作強烈、較不尋常的說法。
options: After the shock, he slowly came to his senses.
Her senses were a ticket she bought for the show.
The loud music senses our ears during the concert.
After sleeping, Mia could senses the cold wind clearly.
optionExplanations: 正確：come to his senses 指逐漸恢復清醒或理智。
錯誤：senses 不是可購買的票券。
錯誤：senses 作複數名詞，不能這樣當動詞。
錯誤：sense 作動詞應為 sense，不是 could senses。
questions.explanation: 正確：come to his senses 指逐漸恢復清醒或理智。

questions.meaning: 通常地；典型地
questions.usage: 常用 typically + 動詞，或 typically + 形容詞；表示常見特徵。
options: The photo is typically because it has two people.
We typically the lunch near the river each day.
Our teacher typically arrives early on Mondays.
The train typically at seven and leaves at eight.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：typically 不能單獨作表語形容詞；可用 typical。
錯誤：typically 是副詞，不能單獨作主要動詞。
正確：typically 修飾 arrives，表示老師通常提早到。
錯誤：typically 不能取代 arrives 等動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：typically 修飾 arrives，表示老師通常提早到。

questions.meaning: 玩弄某人的感情（比喻）
questions.usage: 指不真誠地對待對方的感情；帶有負面評價。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「play with someone’s heart」？
options: He played with her heart to check her blood pressure.
He played with her heart by making promises he never kept.
He played with her heart by showing her a card trick.
He played with her heart because she had a red coat.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：檢查血壓不叫 play with someone’s heart。
正確：不斷給出不打算履行的承諾，符合玩弄感情的意思。
錯誤：紙牌魔術不代表玩弄感情，較自然為 played a card trick。
錯誤：紅色外套與玩弄感情沒有關聯。
questions.explanation: 正確：不斷給出不打算履行的承諾，符合玩弄感情的意思。

questions.meaning: 彷彿上天送來的；來自天上的（文學語氣）
questions.usage: 常用於讚美某人或某件事像天賜的禮物；不是普通寄件說法。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「sent from above」？
options: The bus ticket was sent from above the station roof.
The office email was sent from above the desk yesterday.
The parcel was sent from above the blue mailbox today.
Her kind help felt like a gift sent from above.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：車票的寄件來源不會用這個比喻。
錯誤：一般郵件來源應說 sent from the office，而非 above the desk。
錯誤：包裹的寄送地點不能如此描述。
正確：把幫助比作上天賜予的禮物，符合詩意用法。
questions.explanation: 正確：把幫助比作上天賜予的禮物，符合詩意用法。

questions.meaning: 沉浸在幻想中（詩意、非固定常用片語）
questions.usage: 歌詞中描述沉浸於幻想；日常較常說 daydream 或 dream the day away。
options: She sat by the window, dreaming away the afternoon.
She is dreaming away her bike to the library tomorrow.
He was dreaming away his dinner into the cold oven.
They were dreaming away to open the classroom door.
optionExplanations: 正確：dream away the afternoon 表示把午後時光消磨在幻想中。
錯誤：dream away 不能用來表示騎車去圖書館。
錯誤：dream away 不表示把餐點放入烤箱。
錯誤：此處不能接 to open 表示開門的動作。
questions.explanation: 正確：dream away the afternoon 表示把午後時光消磨在幻想中。

questions.meaning: 真正地；確實地
questions.usage: 用來加強真誠或程度；常修飾形容詞或動詞。
options: The driver truly his car beside the shopping mall.
I truly appreciate the time you spent helping me.
The music truly to the park on Sunday afternoon.
The students were truly the classroom after lunch.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：truly 不能取代 parked 等動詞。
正確：truly appreciate 表示真心感激。
錯誤：truly 不是表示移動的動詞。
錯誤：truly 不能代替 in 等介系詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：truly appreciate 表示真心感激。

questions.meaning: 存在
questions.usage: 描述某個人、事物或現象確實存在，為不及物動詞。
options: Some rare birds still exist on this small island.
Many old stories exist a book in our library.
The scientist exists a new planet every summer.
Animals exist the large cage near the museum.
optionExplanations: 正確：稀有鳥類仍在小島上存在，符合 exist 的用法。
錯誤：描述故事收錄在書中，可說 appear in a book。
錯誤：發現行星用 discovers，不用 exists。
錯誤：exist 不能直接接 cage 當受詞；可說 live in。
questions.explanation: 正確：稀有鳥類仍在小島上存在，符合 exist 的用法。

questions.meaning: 傻瓜；做出愚蠢事情的人
questions.usage: 可自嘲，也可責備他人；對人直接使用可能不禮貌。
options: The coach fooled the door to arrive before nine.
I bought a fool of milk to make the pancakes.
My brother is fool because his backpack is heavy.
I felt like a fool after forgetting my own phone number.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：fooled the door 在這種語境毫無合理意思。
錯誤：fool 不是牛奶的計量單位。
錯誤：單數可數名詞 fool 前須有 a，且背包重並不代表愚笨。
正確：忘記自己的電話號碼後自嘲像傻瓜，語意自然。
questions.explanation: 正確：忘記自己的電話號碼後自嘲像傻瓜，語意自然。

questions.meaning: 請全體上車／登船！
questions.usage: 車長或工作人員通知乘客準備搭乘的呼喊。
options: All aboard! The soup is ready in the kitchen.
All aboard! The movie is funny and very short.
All aboard! The train is leaving in two minutes.
All aboard! Please put your homework on the desk.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：用餐通知不是乘車或登船的呼喊。
錯誤：電影有趣與否不適合用這句提醒。
正確：火車即將發車，呼喊 All aboard! 很自然。
錯誤：收作業不需要通知乘客上車。
questions.explanation: 正確：火車即將發車，呼喊 All aboard! 很自然。

questions.meaning: 將某物掉入／丟進某處
questions.usage: drop + 物品 + into + 地點；可指不小心掉落或刻意投入。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「drop something into」？
options: They dropped the river into a phone during the trip.
He dropped his phone into the river by mistake.
She dropped into her keys the bag before the trip.
I dropped into the bus my ticket as I walked home.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：物品與地點位置顛倒，並且語意不通。
正確：手機不小心掉進河裡，搭配自然。
錯誤：語序應是 dropped her keys into the bag。
錯誤：drop something into 的物品通常放在 drop 後面。
questions.explanation: 正確：手機不小心掉進河裡，搭配自然。

questions.meaning: 在許多方面；以許多方式
questions.usage: 描述某個想法、感受或事物體現在多個不同方面。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「in so many ways」？
options: The blue bag is in so many ways under the desk.
The cake weighs in so many ways before we eat it.
We drove in so many ways at exactly six o’clock.
Our new school is better in so many ways.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：此處只說書包位置，不是多個方面。
錯誤：weigh 是測量重量，不以 in so many ways 代替重量。
錯誤：要描述多條路線可說 by many different routes。
正確：學校在許多方面更好，搭配自然。
questions.explanation: 正確：學校在許多方面更好，搭配自然。
